items.text: Saquon Barkley expected to play per ETR then confirmed ACTIVE for MNF vs DAL; Rapoport and Eagles inactives corroborate up with Dickerson/Stowers.
items.why: Hamstring; expected and officially active Monday.
items.implication: Start as RB1; monitor snap share post-absence.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed GTD/optimism in weekend summary then confirmed ACTIVE vs Raiders after calf issue; Schefter noted Rams optimistic Saturday with no setbacks expected.
items.why: Calf injury, DNP Friday but feeling better Saturday per sources; officially active Sunday.
items.implication: Start as WR1/elite option; no major role loss expected.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets likely if no in-game limitation.

items.text: Breece Hall GTD/pessimism in ETR summary; Rapoport sources said unlikely then officially inactive after limited practice returning from quad strain.
items.why: Quad strain, missed prior 3 games, limited practices, early return risk.
items.implication: Sit; committee or backup (Allen) handles full load vs MIA.

items.text: Jonah Coleman LOVE/upgrade: first game back led Broncos backfield 50% snaps, 41% rush, 34% routes; Dobbins only 21% snaps, Harvey fluky TD.
items.why: Immediate lead shares post-return; preseason call validated.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value-touch thesis: worst runner efficiency (last YPC, low EPA/RYOE) yet RB13 PPR PPG via 9 inside-5 carries + league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.why: Volume/red-zone/target share overrides poor efficiency metrics.
items.implication: Hold/start as RB2; ceiling intact via opportunity.
items.opportunity: Inside-5 carries, targets lead all RBs; goal-line role.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs turned ankle on purposeful slide but Levitan says almost certainly fine; ETR watching list.
items.why: Purposeful slide, no structural concern indicated.

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT in weekend injury summary (ankle); multiple reports confirm third straight miss, Huntley starts.
items.implication: Sit QB; Flowers/Andrews downgrade without dual-threat.
items.opportunity: Huntley game script more pass-heavy or limited.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT; Eagles receiver corps thinned for MNF, elevating others like Lemon potential.
items.implication: Sit both; Eagles pass game redistributes.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Goedert, remaining WRs, or rookies.

items.text: Josh Jacobs listed IN and activated/expected to play; Berry discusses ROS fantasy value post-return.
items.why: Activated from absence; full participant context.
items.implication: RB2/flex with lead role potential ROS.
items.opportunity: Carries, red-zone share in Packers backfield.

items.text: Berry calls to put respect on Tee Higgins name (upgrade/love signal post-performance).
items.why: Strong recent output warrants higher regard in rankings/start decisions.

items.text: Tony Pollard exploded Sunday; Berry advises sell-high if possible in fantasy trades.
items.why: Big game spike; sustainable role questionable long-term.
items.implication: Trade for more stable assets while value high.
items.opportunity: Recent carries/TDs elevated but monitor depth chart.

items.text: Texans routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24 (clear lead), Tank Dell only 6 in first game back since 2024; Noel 15 left early turf toe.
items.why: Collins dominated routes; Dell limited return snaps.
items.implication: Nico locked WR1; Dell handcuff/watch for ramp-up.

items.text: Xavier Worthy ran 33 routes (lead) on 36 Mahomes dropbacks in second game without Rashee Rice; career never topped 83 rec yards in 37 games despite opportunity.
items.why: High route share post-Rice hamstring but historical ceiling cap.
items.implication: WR3/flex with volume but limited upside; fade pure ceiling plays.
items.opportunity: 33 routes, clear WR1 role without Rice.
items.conflict: High usage vs low historical production ceiling.

items.text: Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) per Levitan, uncertain severity; ETR watching with Tracy.
items.implication: Monitor practice; potential sit or limited.
items.opportunity: If out, NYG backfield opens for others.
